evidence: Executed esb-canonical-transformation-bounds with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced 10 endpoint models, 90 pairwise directed transformations, 20 canonical boundary transformations, a nominal reduction of 70, and ratio 0.2222.
Recomputed ordered non-self mappings as 10 multiplied by 9 and canonical in-and-out mappings as 2 multiplied by 10.
Recomputed the ratio as 20 divided by 90, approximately 0.222222 and formatted to four decimal places.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts are exact under the declared one-model, one-version, fully connected, directed convention; actual estates may be sparse multigraphs with several transformations per boundary.
